YIFBedding

Indulge in tailored comfort with our selection of premium bed linen, custom mattresses and toppers, duvets, pillows, decorative cushions, and daybed covers – all designed to fit your yacht’s dimensions perfectly.

  • Bed Linen
  • Mattresses & Toppers
  • Duvets & Pillows
  • Daybed Covers
  • Throws
  • Decorative Pillows

bed linen

Experience bespoke bed linen tailored precisely to your yacht’s unique dimensions and requirements. We craft these in-house to guarantee a perfect fit and premium quality, or alternatively, provide you with a curated selection of the finest luxury brands to elevate your onboard comfort.

mattresses and toppers

Enhance your sleeping experience with custom mattresses and toppers, expertly crafted to match the unique shapes and sizes of your yacht’s cabins. Whether handmade by our skilled team or selected from renowned luxury brands, each mattress/topper delivers superior comfort, support, and durability – engineered for confined, irregular spaces and the demanding conditions of marine environments.

duvets & pillows

We offer a carefully curated selection of premium duvets and pillows, chosen to meet the highest standards of comfort, quality, and performance at sea. With a wide range of sizes, materials, and fillings available, we help you find the perfect combination to suit your yacht’s needs.

daybed covers

Protect and beautify your day beds with bespoke covers crafted to your yacht’s exact specifications. Available as expertly made in-house creations or through an exclusive selection of premium brands, our covers combine durability and elegance.

throws

Our throws are made-to-measure using premium natural materials such as cashmere, wool, linen, and blends tailored to suit both comfort and durability. Designed to complement your interior while meeting specific sizing or storage requirements, they add warmth and sophistication to your living spaces.

decorative pillows

Enhance your bedroom with our custom decorative cushions. Each cushion features unique designs and fabrics, carefully selected to reflect each client’s individual style. Whether made in-house or sourced from exclusive design brands, our creations are tailored to your space, combining elegance, comfort, and refined detailing.

One partner. Infinite tailored solutions.
